dedupe_keys.name: google digital buildings ontology and toolset

description: The Digital Buildings project is Google's open-source effort to create a uniform schema and toolset for structured information about buildings and building-installed equipment; a version of it is used by Google to manage buildings in its own portfolio. It has an ontology (the terminology box) in YAML and RDF/OWL formats, building configuration files that map the ontology to raw real-world data (the assertion box), and tools: ABEL to convert between a templated Google Sheet and a configuration file, an Explorer for ontology types, and instance and ontology validators. The project was inspired by Project Haystack and Brick and aims at cross-compatibility or convergence with them. Coverage: generic commercial buildings. Access: source and ontology on GitHub. Licence: Apache 2.0; free. Caveats: the ontology reflects the needs of one large corporate portfolio. Simulation uses are standardising equipment and point metadata so that analytics, fault detection and digital twin models port between buildings. Related records: Brick Schema and Project Haystack.
